StateTree.Comment: Combat subtree for Resto Shaman bots (run by STAI_Combat_Shaman.xml)

Task.Comment: mana of the bot: manaPct, onManaChanged
the totems selected for the bot (outdoor, or the master's dungeon stage) that are not up: needs, onTotemMissing; onTotemsChanged when the selection changed
the rooms of the dungeon (InstanceSubsystem stages): stagePosition (the bot's point in the master's room, saved by rtsc), stagePositionFrom, pathBlocked

Task.name: Position Yourself
Task.Comment: movement goal: the bot's point in the master's room (rtsc / the stage file) during the fight too, above Attack Range (the bot casts from there while the target is in range)

State.name: Mana Potion
State.Comment: low mana: the best mana potion of the bags (fails while none can be used, not selected again for 3s)

State.name: Totems
State.Comment: a selected totem is not up: drops the missing totems one per GCD; fails while none can be cast (mana), not selected again for 3s

Task.Comment: placeholder until the rest of the combat exists: waits briefly (a totem that failed is tried again) or until a delegate sends the tree elsewhere
